blocks.text: Malacañang on Monday said President Marcos had no involvement in the P50-million bounty for the arrest of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, attributing the decision solely to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla and Philippine National Police (PNP) officials.
